data.content_ref: inline:Attach to every materialized attack edge its warrant-chain provenance so that each accepted node carries a traceable committed root. The carriage relation is the authority for warrant materialization; extend it with a provenance ledger recording, per attack edge, the chain of warrants and closures that produced it. Acceptance labels stay a pure function of the graph, so the fixpoint is untouched; the ledger makes 'validity of every committed root' checkable in polynomial time at commit time, converting a global invariant into a local per-edge certificate.
